sources.title: Overdrafts | Apply for an Arranged Overdraft with Monzo

brands.evidence: Yes. Monzo offers arranged overdrafts of up to £2,000 on UK personal current accounts.

client_claims.text: Monzo offers arranged overdrafts of up to £2,000 on UK personal current accounts.
You must be 18 or over, and the limit you're offered depends on eligibility.
You pay interest only on the amount you use, not on the full limit.
client_claims.note: No fact covers overdraft interest calculation.

client_claims.text: Monzo offers three variable effective annual rates: 19%, 29% or 39%, depending on credit score.
At Monzo's representative rate of 39%, borrowing £1,200 for 30 days costs £32.94 in interest.
client_claims.note: No fact covers overdraft cost examples.
